items.title: How government spending relates to eco-social outcomes: a global comparative analysis from 2005 to 2019
items.title_en: How government spending relates to eco-social outcomes: a global comparative analysis from 2005 to 2019
items.title_zh: 政府支出与生态社会成果之间的关系：2005年至2019年的全球比较分析
items.summary_en: Governments play a central role in achieving eco-social outcomes, understood as the joint attainment of social wellbeing and environmental sustainability. Yet empirical evidence on how government spending relates to eco-social outcomes remains limited. This study examines the relationship between government spending, human needs satisfaction, and carbon implications across 116 countries between 2005 and 2019 using input-output and regression analyses. To account for global climate justice, we adjust carbon intensities (CO2e/US$) according to countries’ fair shares of the remaining global carbon budget. These equity-adjusted carbon intensities capture both the carbon efficiency of spending and countries’ position relative to their fair carbon budgets. We find that higher government spending is generally associated with better social outcomes, although returns diminish at higher spending levels and depend on spending composition. Spending on education and recreation, social protection, and public administration is linked to better social outcomes and comparatively low equity-adjusted carbon intensities. By contrast, industry-related government spending consistently exhibits high intensities, suggesting potential carbon lock-ins. For most spending categories, intensities tend to be lower in countries with better social outcomes, with housing as a notable exception. Order and defense spending is associated with lower social outcomes despite substantial carbon impacts. Across key welfare sectors, including education and recreation, health and environment, and social protection, government spending is linked to more favorable eco-social outcomes than household spending, suggesting advantages of public and collective provisioning.
items.summary_zh: 在实现生态社会成果（即社会福祉与环境可持续性的共同实现）方面，政府发挥着核心作用。 然而，关于政府支出与生态社会成果之间关系的实证证据仍然有限。本研究利用投入产出分析和回归分析，考察了2005年至2019年间116个国家政府支出、人类需求满足度与碳影响之间的关系。 为了体现全球气候正义，我们根据各国在全球剩余碳预算中的公平份额，对碳强度（CO2e/美元）进行了调整。这些经过公平性调整的碳强度既反映了支出的碳效率，也体现了各国相对于其公平碳预算的地位。 我们发现，较高的政府支出通常与更好的社会成果相关，尽管在较高支出水平下边际收益会递减，且取决于支出的构成。 教育与休闲、社会保护以及公共行政领域的支出与更佳的社会成果相关，且其经公平性调整后的碳强度相对较低。相比之下，与工业相关的政府支出始终表现出较高的碳强度，这表明可能存在碳锁定现象。对于大多数支出类别而言，社会成果越好的国家，其碳强度往往越低，但住房领域是一个显著的例外。 尽管公共秩序和国防支出对碳排放产生显著影响，但其与较低的社会成果相关。在包括教育与娱乐、卫生与环境以及社会保护在内的关键福利领域，政府支出带来的生态社会成果优于家庭支出，这表明公共和集体供给具有优势。

items.title: Biodiversity credits hold promise, yet credit-generating protocols require safeguards to realize potential
items.title_en: Biodiversity credits hold promise, yet credit-generating protocols require safeguards to realize potential
items.title_zh: 生物多样性信用机制前景广阔，但要充分发挥其潜力，信用生成方案仍需建立相应的保障措施
items.summary_en: Given the existing gap in biodiversity funding, mobilizing private finance will be essential to achieving global biodiversity conservation goals, especially across lower- and middle-income countries with limited capacity and public finance. The emerging voluntary biodiversity market (VBM) holds promise to leverage private finance for biodiversity, but credit-generating protocols must be robust to prevent greenwashing and maximize effectiveness. In this study, the first to move beyond theoretical critiques and general market assessments of the VBM, we extracted details of program structure and crediting issuance from protocols for 13 relatively well-established biodiversity-crediting organizations. With these data, we evaluated protocols’ alignment with both conservation and restoration biology principles and lessons learned from the voluntary carbon market (VCM). We find that action must be taken to improve quantification of biodiversity impacts, especially incorporating patch size and connectivity in crediting and assessing projects on ecologically relevant timelines. Further, safeguards for additionality, leakage, risk, and verification from the VCM must be more robustly integrated in the VBM, and deep engagement and investment in local communities must be improved to ensure durable biodiversity-positive outcomes.
items.summary_zh: 鉴于当前生物多样性资金缺口，调动私人资本对于实现全球生物多样性保护目标至关重要，特别是在能力有限且公共财政资源匮乏的中低收入国家。新兴的自愿性生物多样性市场（VBM）有望为生物多样性保护撬动私人资本，但信用生成协议必须足够健全，以防止“洗绿”行为并最大限度地提高成效。 本研究是首项超越对自愿生物多样性市场（VBM）的理论批判和一般性市场评估的研究，我们从13家相对成熟的生物多样性信用组织的工作规程中，提取了项目结构和信用额度发放的详细信息。 基于这些数据，我们评估了这些协议与保护生物学和恢复生物学原则的契合度，以及从自愿碳市场（VCM）中汲取的经验教训。我们发现，必须采取行动改进生物多样性影响的量化工作，特别是将斑块大小和连通性纳入信用核算，并在生态相关的时限内评估项目。 此外，必须将自愿碳市场（VCM）中关于额外性、泄漏、风险和核查的保障措施更牢固地融入生物多样性碳信用市场（VBM），并加强与当地社区的深度互动及投资，以确保实现持久的、对生物多样性有利的成果。

items.title: Resilience as a governing principle in water governance
items.title_en: Resilience as a governing principle in water governance
items.title_zh: 韧性作为水治理的基本原则
items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 17 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01972-yWater governance often treats resilience as an end state, achieved mainly through technocratic decision-making and standard engineering tools. Drawing on five international cases, we argue that resilience should instead guide governance design and operation through adaptability, coordination, learning and accountability.
items.summary_zh: 《自然·可持续性》（Nature Sustainability），在线发表于：2026年11月17日；doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01972-y 水治理往往将韧性视为一种最终状态，主要通过技术官僚式的决策和标准工程工具来实现。 基于五个国际案例，我们认为，韧性应通过适应性、协调性、学习能力和问责机制，来指导治理的设计与运作。
